personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass/Luxe cinematic surfaces (Dark Forest Edition)
personality_one_liner: A high-density, premium productivity tool blending the precision of Linear with a dark, cinematic forest aesthetic.

spacing.rule: Generous margins (16pt/24pt) around screen edges, tight grouping (4pt/8pt) for related metadata. No orphans on the right.

do's: Bottom tab bar (frosted over scrolling content)
Pinned dates on calendar agenda view
Floating action buttons with brand tint

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure gateway with a cinematic forest backdrop emphasizing the brand's premium outdoor identity.

states.loading: Subtle gold spinner over darkened forest image.

screens.layout: Hero image background covering the screen. Gradient scrim (top-to-bottom transparent to surface) covering the bottom 60%. Login form (email/pass + Google CTA) inside a frosted glass card or directly on the darkened scrim at the bottom. Typography display uses negative tracking.

screens.name: Kalendarz
screens.purpose: A high-density monthly and agenda view to instantly grasp event load and upcoming duties.

states.loading: Skeleton grid matching the calendar structure.
states.empty: Illustration of a quiet forest + 'Brak wydarzeń w tym miesiącu'.
states.error: Retry state with small warning icon.

screens.layout: Top section: seamless calendar strip or grid without borders (Linear style). Current day indicated by brandPrimary solid circle. Bottom section: Agenda list of events. Each list item uses surfaceSecondary with 0.5pt subtle borders, displaying time, event title, and color-coded status pills. Sticky month headers with frosted glass.

screens.name: Ostatnie
screens.purpose: Chronological feed of recently added/edited events acting as a quick-access workspace history.

states.empty: Icon of an empty tray + 'Brak ostatnich aktywności'.

screens.layout: Header with title and a horizontally scrolling row of pill-shaped chips (Sort/Filter). Below: dense list rows. Each row: Event type icon in a brandTertiary rounded square, Title (event name), Subtitle (date/time), trailing metadata (price/status). No shadows, only subtle 1px divider between rows.

screens.name: Oferta
screens.purpose: A premium catalog of adult, kids, and workshop packages to easily build and send offers.
screens.layout: Multi-column grid or large single-column cards. Top: Segmented control (Dorośli, Dzieci, Warsztaty). Cards use imagery (wooden table, alpacas) with a 70% dark scrim at the bottom, overlaid with white text (Title, Price). A primary 'Wyślij ofertę' CTA floats as a glass FAB at the bottom right.

screens.name: Koszty
screens.purpose: Ledger for tracking workspace expenses with a clear top-line total.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty wallet + 'Brak kosztów w tym miesiącu'.

screens.layout: Top: KPI Card in surfaceSecondary showing 'Całkowite koszty' in large display typography. Below: List of expenses. Each row shows category icon, description, and negative amount in red/white. FAB at bottom right to 'Dodaj koszt'.

screens.name: Pracownicy
screens.purpose: Staff directory and shift management with clear role distinction.
screens.layout: List view. Each row features a real photo or initials avatar in surfaceTertiary. Next to it: Name, and a role badge (e.g., Szef, Obsługa, Animator) using semantic tint chips (e.g., brandTertiary for Szef). Tapping opens a bottom sheet with their shift history.

screens.name: Statystyki
screens.purpose: Financial and operational command center with real-time charts.

states.empty: Not enough data to display stats.

screens.layout: 2-column grid for KPI cards (Przychód, Zysk, Liczba imprez) utilizing surfaceSecondary and subtle borders. Below: A smooth line chart (using react-native-chart-kit or similar) with the line in brandPrimary (Gold). Filter chips at the top (Miesiąc/Rok). Bottom section has export action rows.

screens.name: Event detail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive form and dashboard for a single event.
screens.layout: Hero image top (event type photo) with a gradient scrim. Title overlays on the image. Below: Clean, single-column form fields with labels above inputs. Inputs use surfaceTertiary background with no borders until focused (then borderStrong). Expandable sections for 'Pakiet', 'Pracownicy', 'Notatki'. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom 'Zapisz zmiany' in brandPrimary.

login_hero_bg.alt: Dark pine forest covered in thick fog

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT RULE: The background must be dark forest green (#0A120E). Do not use black or navy. Text must be white (#F3F4F6) with muted secondary variants.
Implement a Linear-style 'no shadow' elevation system. Distinguish cards and lists using surfaceSecondary (#111D16) and a very subtle 0.5pt border (#1A2B21).
Use Phosphor Icons. Ensure sizes map to an 8pt grid (16, 24, 32).
Typography must feel premium: Use Satoshi for display headings with tight/negative letter spacing (-0.5px to -1px) to give a sharp, authoritative feel. Use Geist for readable body text.
On image cards (Oferta / Event Detail), strictly apply the gradient scrim layer pattern from top-transparent to 70%+ surface background at the bottom. Text overlays must be in this scrim area.
Forms (Event detail) should use labels above inputs. Inputs should not have a floating label. Keep it clean and single column.
The primary action (e.g. Save, Send Offer) on scrolling screens must be sticky at the bottom, either floating or pinned with a frosted glass background.
Include haptics explicitly as detailed in the haptics block.
